tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgad po mdzub btsugs kyi gdams ngag bzhugs so// nges don gyi 'khrid thob nas sbyor ba skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rgad po mdzub btsugs kyi gdams ngag sems/ yid/ shes pa/ rig pa/ zhes gang zer yang / nga rnal 'byor mkhan gyi/ rang snang stong pa/ thol le ba 'di ka ngo shes pa'i ngang la ma yengs bar bzhag ngos ma zin la 'chor na/ bdag gam ngar 'dzin du/ lhang lhang ba 'di rang yin/ 'di mnyam bzhag gi ngo shes na/ chos nyid stong gsal/ rang rig gi gsal snang / bar snang stong pa'i dbyings lta bu'i/ stong pa'i kun shes mkhan/ 'di rang yin/ rang tsho zin na/ kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zhes/ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ chos sku yin/ de yang ma bcos pa'i/ ye nas kyi shes pa/ snang stong rang rig rgyu gsal ba/ de ka la/ ye shes zer/ de yang stong pas kun shes shing / rang rig pas/ rig pa zer/ nyams len rig pa 'di ka'i ngang la/ ma bcos pa rang la bstod pa yin/ 'dzin med/ rang grol 'di ka yengs med rgyun du skyongs/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam/ thun mtshams dran shes brten/ dge rtsa la 'bad do/ /dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rgad po mdzub btsugs kyi gdams ngag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
